name: The Most Suspicious Man in the World
source:
When Oliver Hemlock, professional skeptic, is invited to film a seance at a recently-remodeled, supposedly-haunted island resort, he's fairly certain it's a trap. Not only are the paranormal investigators he'll be filming with vastly more popular than he is, but the invitation came directly from the psychic medium... a former stage magician who also happens be his ex. His general paranoia is further justified when, the night before the big trip, he meets...THE MOST SUSPICIOUS MAN IN THE WORLD.

[From [url=https://ghostclown.itch.io/most-suspicious-man]itch.io[/url]]
